notes.title: CEIBA is available NOW!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/29064054/49b03560bf92e49b37ca2953b75ab5ca2e5e748e.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398940/Ceiba/

We are pleased to announce that CEIBA, the new game from the authors of Athanasy, is now available on Steam!

Enjoy the atmosphere of unique science fiction together with the crew of the research station "Ailanthus"! The mysterious plant world of "Ailanthus" hides many secrets, some of which you, in the role of the young laboratory technician Ein, will be able to solve. In this you will be helped - or maybe hindered - by the other crew members: the commander of the biolab Yoli, the chief engineer Sabu and the charming but uncommunicative Miri, who carries the heavy burden of a communications engineer. Why heavy, you ask? There are specific reasons, which Ein is about to find out. Reasons that can shake not only the small cozy world of the lab technician, but also the whole "Ailanthus".

CEIBA visual novel present not just a fascinating story, but also a wonderful work of artists, who tried to convey even in small details the plant world of "Ailanthus", contrasting sharply with the gloomy planet somewhere under the clouds. The music design is not lagging behind, which intensifies the atmosphere of the unknown. And the reader familiar with the Wirion studio's previous project "Athanasy" may find suspicious details linking these novels.

Wirion once again show a high level of quality. This time the main theme of the novel is symbiosis, and also... However, you can find out everything yourself, can't you?

notes.title: DOTTY NEWS
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/7e89ab53f45c5ddf26512a2172da5f8ea13694a7.png
Dotty here! We are glad to announce the upcoming release of the novel we've been working on for almost 2 years. (yeah, it's not Totem City you hoped for, we know, sorry, we've ran into some difficulties again, apart from the game being already finished late November). This novel about the guy, who learnt a way to possess other people's lives, it turned out pretty cool, we think. ;3 The game is going to be released this April and it already got its steam page, so you can add it to a wishlist so you won't miss it.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AUiIvp7r-lo
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269350/Neuronaut/
Speaking of other news, we are preparing 2 nukige to be released on Steam pretty soon, the first one is called "Throne of Succubus" and the other "Swordsman Tournament", we've already finished English localization for the first one, so it's gonna come out pretty soon.  \(★ω★)/

Swordsman Tournament is our collaboration project with Salamandra88, which is going to be something like Puzzle Quest, but with cute girls to battle with. :3
Here are some concepts and screenshots:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/f57f7ff9c6b931b75a47a0bdd9f7cebe31774d96.png
One of the contestants - Shisuka
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29064054/e1c50fa75ef07b6e58ecb7d4c05474706811bbae.jpg
Tournament overseer

Oh, and Salamandra is currently finishing her otome novel called "Heiress of Sorcery", we already made steam page for it too, so you can watch the trailer and add it to your wishlist too C: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aBT5assG0lk
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202870/The_Heiress_of_Sorcery/

So yeah, soon we'll keep you home with some of our cool games to come, so be well, friends. o( ❛ᴗ❛ )o
